Thanks again for the demo last week. We've run this through procurement and legal on our side and attached a redlined SOW (Elmwood_SOW_v3_redline.pdf). Two items are blocking our sign:

Vanessa / Laura — I reviewed Elmwood_SOW_v3_redline.pdf and added tags for high/medium/low risk items. Summary:

- Liability cap: Elmwood requests $2M. Our standard is $1M for this segment; given ACV ($820k) I recommend a compromise cap at $1.5M if commercial signs off. Anything above $1.5M should be escalated to the CRO + GC (exec sign-off).

- Indemnity: they request broader indemnification language (includes downstream integration claims and a carve-out we don't typically accept). We can agree to indemnify for our product defects and third-party IP claims limited to direct damages. Do not agree to unlimited downstream carve-outs. If they insist, Legal needs exec approval plus a narrow time/usage limitation.

- Warranty: they propose a 24-month warranty and service credits that are disproportionate. Recommend 12-month warranty with standard service credits.

- Other asks: the 30% onboarding discount is a commercial decision. From risk perspective, our recommended redlines are: cap at $1.5M, indemnity limited to third-party IP claims and our gross negligence/exclusions unchanged, warranty 12 months.

I attached a redline (Elmwood_SOW_v3_legal_comments.pdf) with suggested alternative language. If commercial wants the full 30% and $2M cap we should route to Aditya for explicit written approval.

Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: Elmwood_SOW_v3_legal_comments.pdf


From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 07 May 2028 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: Elmwood request for exception (summary + recommended path)

Aditya — quick escalation for decision. Summary below; please reply with approval or counter by EOD (Elmwood needs timeline for their finance cycle).

Deal snapshot
- Account: Elmwood.ai (mid-market)
- ARR / Year 1 value: $820,000
- Current SOW: annual subscription + onboarding services; standard cap $1M
- Requests from customer: liability cap $2M, broadened indemnity, 30% first-year discount

Risk / Legal guidance (Marissa):
- Recommend cap compromise to $1.5M (Material risk above $1.5M)
- Indemnity: do NOT accept broad downstream carve-out; limit to third-party IP claims and our product defect liabilities
- Warranty: shorten to 12 months

Commercial ask (Laura):
- 30% discount exceeds deal-desk self-serve thresholds (requires Commercial Head sign-off).

Options for exec decision (my recommendation italicized):
1) Approve $2M cap + 30% discount + expanded indemnity (High risk; closes faster)
2) Approve $1.5M cap + 20% discount + indemnity limited to third-party IP (Recommended balance)
3) Decline cap/indemnity changes; offer 15% discount and standard contract (Slower, may lose the deal)

Request: Please confirm which option you approve or propose an alternative. If you approve option 2, Legal will finalize language and I will send the updated SOW for signature (we can use DocuSign).

Thanks — V

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, MidMarket
Redwood Inference

Vanessa, proceed with updating the SOW per Marissa's redline and send via DocuSign. Laura, please record the commercial exception and update HubSpot (deal id RDW-DEAL-2028-0419-ELM).
